result:
I’d make everyone able to genuinely understand, from the inside, how their choices affect other people.

Not mind-reading — just enough immediate empathy that cruelty becomes harder, indifference rarer, and cooperation more natural. A lot of the world’s worst problems look like failures of imagination about other people’s pain.
